primitives.name: Vector Quantized Tokenizer
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Tokenizer: VQ-VAE-style discrete autoencoder E: R^{h×w×3} → {1..N}^K (K tokens from vocabulary size N; CNN encoder, CNN decoder; argmin over embedding table E={e_i}).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'h': 'height of image frame (pixels)', 'w': 'width of image frame (pixels)', 'N': 'vocabulary size of discrete tokens', 'K': 'number of tokens per frame'}
primitives.assumptions: Observations are image frames; discrete tokenization preserves semantic structure; encoder-decoder architecture learns compact representations.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When input images lack sufficient visual distinctiveness for stable quantization.

layer2.mapping: Maps high-dimensional pixel space to low-dimensional discrete token space, enabling efficient sequence modeling.
layer2.telemetry: Reconstruction error, token entropy, perceptual similarity metrics.

primitives.name: Token Transformer World Model
primitives.verbatim_quote: - World model G: GPT-like transformer over interleaved frame/action tokens: (z_0^1..z_0^K, a_0, r_0, d_0, z_1^1..z_1^K, a_1, ...).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'z_t^k': 'k-th token of frame at time t', 'a_t': 'action at time t', 'r_t': 'reward at time t', 'd_t': 'termination flag at time t', 'L': 'imagination horizon'}
primitives.assumptions: Dynamics are Markovian; token sequences encode sufficient information for prediction; autoregressive structure captures temporal dependencies.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When token sequences fail to represent key environmental features or when long-range dependencies exceed model capacity.

layer2.mapping: Encodes transition probabilities between tokenized states using self-attention mechanisms.
layer2.telemetry: Cross-entropy loss on next-token prediction, reward MSE, termination CE.

primitives.name: Imagination Loop
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Imagination: encode initial frame to tokens, policy π predicts action from decoded/current tokens, G autoregressively unfolds next-frame tokens + predicts reward r̂_t and termination d̂_t.
primitives.assumptions: Policy is deterministic or stochastic but tractable; world model accurately simulates dynamics; imagination horizon sufficient for planning.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When policy fails to generalize across tokenized states or when world model underestimates uncertainty in predictions.

layer2.mapping: Generates synthetic trajectories by combining token encoding, policy sampling, and transformer-based rollout.
layer2.telemetry: Trajectory consistency, reward prediction accuracy, termination event frequency.

reasoning_traces.think:
The core innovation lies in treating world dynamics as a language modeling task where each observation is encoded into discrete tokens via a VQ-VAE. These tokens are then processed by an autoregressive transformer that predicts future tokens, rewards, and termination flags. The policy operates entirely within this imagined space, trained on synthetic rollouts generated by the world model. This framework allows for highly sample-efficient reinforcement learning because it decouples policy learning from real-world interaction. The key mathematical duality emerges between pixel-space dynamics and token-space dynamics, where the former is replaced by a structured symbolic representation that retains essential semantic content. Failure modes include poor tokenization leading to loss of information, insufficient imagination horizon causing suboptimal decisions, and inaccurate world model predictions undermining policy quality.
